title: Choose an architecture
summary: A small team needs a note-taking web app. Compare at least two architectures and write a decision record that you could defend in a design review.

requirements.text: You stated the context and the constraints in your own words.
You described at least two realistic architecture options.
You compared the options on cost, complexity, risk and fit for this team.
You made a clear decision and explained why you chose it.
You listed the consequences and risks of your decision.
You said how you would verify the decision works, and what would make you revisit it.
